title: Security and reliability update
body: Strata now verifies command-installer downloads, limits imported archives, protects privileged windows, and rejects unsafe external navigation.

title: A new layer for Strata
body: The Play screen has been rebuilt around your active instance, profile, loadout, and a faster launch flow.

title: Updates now arrive automatically
body: Strata can download new main-branch releases in the background and install them on restart.

title: Discord presence is ready
body: Show what you are playing, your current instance, and session status directly on Discord.
